author: Clijmart
body:
Hey,
yeah... I started another map...
But before I go on with building. I just want your feedback on the monument placement of it.
The map has 5 monuments, placed in the caves.
The spawnpoint is in the bigger cave in the middle.

Screeny:
http://imgur.com/nOrupeM

Please send me some feedback/ideas on what I should add and what you think about this idea.
- Clijmart

Other than that, the maps seems to be good at the moment.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Mostly refer to what Fouled said ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Another thing is the Monument placement might be weird as the cave is next to all 5 monuments and the only real way to get up to the entrance is to stack up to the entrance. Basically, you can camp your spawn cave and shoot people who stack up.

If you can somehow make this work that would be pretty nice :)

reminds me of Tectum with the underground monuments :CCCCCCCCCC
